# Feature: Brand Assets

## Overview
Create a comprehensive brand asset management system that handles storage, versioning, and deployment of business branding elements across all interfaces.

## User Stories

1. Asset Management
   - As a business owner
   - I want to upload and manage brand assets
   - So our brand is consistently represented

2. Color Schemes
   - As a brand manager
   - I want to define brand color schemes
   - So our interfaces match our brand

3. Typography Settings
   - As a brand manager
   - I want to set brand typography
   - So text presentation matches our brand

4. Asset Versioning
   - As a marketing manager
   - I want to version control brand assets
   - So we can manage brand evolution

5. Asset Distribution
   - As a system administrator
   - I want assets automatically distributed
   - So all interfaces update consistently

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create asset management interface
- [ ] Implement color scheme system
- [ ] Build typography manager
- [ ] Create version control system
- [ ] Implement asset distribution
- [ ] Add asset optimization
- [ ] Create preview system
- [ ] Implement CDN integration
- [ ] Add usage analytics
- [ ] Create backup system

## Acceptance Criteria
- Assets upload properly
- Colors apply correctly
- Typography renders properly
- Versions maintain accurately
- Distribution works reliably
- Optimization improves performance
- Preview shows accurately
- Analytics track usage

## Technical Notes
- Use CDN for delivery
- Implement proper optimization
- Use background jobs for processing
- Cache asset data
- Follow asset management patterns
- Implement proper logging

## Estimate
- Story Points: 8
- Time Estimate: 1 week

## Dependencies
- Core API system
- Storage system
